review.gaps: Bank is a smooth lofted slab with no gullies or overhangs; flames are sparse tapered spikes, far less dense and bright than the photo and the render is daylight not dusk (no emissive material); hill is a faceted prism; museum and amphitheatre come from the brief, not the photo; stone letters are small blocks.
